methodology.citation_detection: a refuting receipt counts as indexed iff its own repo-relative path (e.g. evidence/audit/<dir>/<file>.dsse.json) appears as a literal substring in RETRACTION-INDEX.md's raw text -- the identity convention RETRACTION-INDEX.md's own 4 existing rows already use for their 'refuted-by receipt path' column.
methodology.determinism: glob.glob() results sorted; no randomness; pure function of on-disk bytes.
methodology.refutation_detection: a receipt's decoded payload `verdict` field is treated as a refutation iff the substring REFUT appears in its uppercased string value -- not hardcoded to the single literal H0_REFUTED, so it would also catch a future receipt spelling it CLAIM_REFUTED or REFUTED.
methodology.scope: every evidence/audit/*/*.dsse.json signed receipt currently on disk (excl. this audit's own output dir and evidence/superseded/)
